name: Cat
otherStatistics: Str -4, Dex +1, Con +0, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -2. Fixed Perception 13. Fixed Stealth 13. Darkvision 30 ft. Languages none.
appearance: A small gray-brown tabby with upright ears, dark flank stripes and a curved tail.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Spanish translation of Monster Vault, p. 342, Gato. XP from the CR table on p. 17.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The cat uses Perception 18 when relying on smell.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit one creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Charming Meow. The cat meows to one creature it can see within 10 ft. The target makes a DC 11 Charisma save. If it fails, it is Charmed until the end of its next turn. Upon a successful save or when the effect ends for that creature, it is immune to this cat’s Charming Meow for 24 hours.

name: Crab
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Str -4, Dex +0, Con +0, Int -5, Wis -1, Cha -4. Fixed Perception 9. Fixed Stealth 12. Keensense 30 ft. Languages none.
appearance: A small olive-brown crab with a rounded shell, splayed legs and two pincers.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Spanish translation of Monster Vault, pp. 338–339, Cangrejo. XP from the CR table on p. 17.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
sections.Actions: Claw. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit one creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage and attaches the crab. While attached, it cannot attack. At the start of each of the crab’s turns, the target takes another 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage. The crab moves with the target without spending movement. It can spend 5 ft. of its movement on its own turn to let go. Any creature, including the target, can use an action to remove it.

name: Crab, Giant
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Str +2, Dex +2, Con +0, Int -5, Wis -1, Cha -4. Fixed Perception 9. Fixed Stealth 14. Keensense 30 ft. Languages none.
appearance: A broad red-orange crab with a ridged shell, pointed walking legs and heavy pincers.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Spanish translation of Monster Vault, p. 339, Cangrejo, Gigante. XP from the CR table on p. 17.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
sections.Actions: Pincer. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit one creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and grapples the target (escape DC 12). The crab has two pincers and can hold one target per pincer.
sections.Bonus actions: Pincer Pinch. Choose one creature that breathes and is grappled by the crab. It must succeed on a DC 12 Strength save. On a failure it cannot speak or cast spells with verbal components, and it begins suffocating as the crab squeezes the air from its lungs. These effects last until the grapple ends.
sections.Escaping the grapple: The grappled creature can take an action to attempt a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to escape. See the Monster Vault errata for the general fixed-DC procedure. https://koboldpress.com/errata/

name: Crocodile
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Str +2, Dex +0, Con +1, Int -4, Wis +0, Cha -3. Fixed Perception 10. Fixed Stealth 12. No special senses. Languages none.
appearance: An olive-brown crocodile with raised back scutes, a long snout and a thick, tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Spanish translation of Monster Vault, pp. 339–340, Cocodrilo. XP from the CR table on p. 17.
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
sections.Condition resistance: Charmed. Advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end that condition.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit one creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 6 piercing damage and grapples the target (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target is Restrained and the crocodile cannot bite another target.
sections.Bonus actions: Death Roll. One creature grappled by the crocodile makes a DC 12 Strength save. It takes 5 (2d4) slashing damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.
sections.Escaping the grapple: The grappled creature can take an action to attempt a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to escape. See the Monster Vault errata for the general fixed-DC procedure. https://koboldpress.com/errata/
sections.Source notes: The Spanish printed Bite damage expression is incomplete, showing 6 ( + 2) with the die missing. The encounter block uses the printed fixed 6 piercing damage.

name: Crocodile, Giant
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Str +8, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -4, Wis +0, Cha -2. Fixed Perception 10. Fixed Stealth 12. No special senses. Languages none.
appearance: A massive dark olive crocodile with spiked back scutes, a long tail and a broad, tooth-lined jaw.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Spanish translation of Monster Vault, p. 340, Cocodrilo, Gigante. XP from the CR table on p. 17.
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
sections.Condition resistance: Charmed. Advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end that condition.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit one creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage and grapples the target (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, the target is Restrained and the crocodile cannot bite another target.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit one target within 10 ft. that the crocodile is not grappling. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 16 Strength save or fall Prone.
sections.Bonus actions: Death Roll. One creature grappled by the crocodile makes a DC 16 Strength save. It takes 7 (2d6) slashing damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.
sections.Escaping the grapple: The grappled creature can take an action to attempt a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to escape. See the Monster Vault errata for the general fixed-DC procedure. https://koboldpress.com/errata/
